raw.query: WITH d AS (SELECT run_id,window_name,encoder_workers,is_current,superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE run_id='sweeps:vision_burst1_s1' AND is_current=true), s AS (SELECT es.t,es.queue_imgs_end,es.busy_workers_end FROM provenance.encoder_series es JOIN d USING(run_id)), marked AS (SELECT s.*,queue_imgs_end>1000 AS hi,CASE WHEN queue_imgs_end>1000 AND NOT COALESCE(LAG(queue_imgs_end>1000) OVER (ORDER BY t),false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_flag FROM s), grouped AS (SELECT marked.*,SUM(start_flag) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS grp FROM marked), excursions AS (SELECT grp,MIN(t) AS start_t,MAX(t) AS end_t,COUNT(*) AS duration_samples,MAX(queue_imgs_end) AS peak FROM grouped WHERE hi GROUP BY grp), gaps AS (SELECT grp,end_t,LEAD(start_t) OVER (ORDER BY start_t) AS next_start FROM excursions), gap_min AS (SELECT g.grp,MIN(s.queue_imgs_end) AS min_queue_between FROM gaps g JOIN s ON s.t>g.end_t AND s.t<g.next_start WHERE g.next_start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.grp), latency AS (SELECT p99_ms,n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE run_id='sweeps:vision_burst1_s1' AND is_current=true AND sla_metric='encoder_delay'), sweep AS (SELECT horizon_s,mechanism,queue_imgs_final FROM provenance.sweep_point WHERE series_run_id='sweeps:vision_burst1_s1'), eda AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS eda_rows FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE run_id='sweeps:vision_burst1_s1') SELECT d.window_name,d.encoder_workers,d.is_current,d.superseded_by,COUNT(*) AS n_samples,MIN(s.t) AS t_min,MAX(s.t) AS t_max,MAX(s.t)-MIN(s.t) AS span_s,ROUND((MAX(s.t)-MIN(s.t))/3600.0,3) AS span_hours,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.queue_imgs_end>1000) AS seconds_gt1000,MAX(s.queue_imgs_end) AS peak_queue,MIN(s.busy_workers_end) FILTER (WHERE s.queue_imgs_end>0) AS min_busy_when_queued,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excursions) AS n_excursions,(SELECT MIN(duration_samples) FROM excursions) AS min_excursion_s,(SELECT MAX(duration_samples) FROM excursions) AS max_excursion_s,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gap_min) AS inter_excursion_gaps,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gap_min WHERE min_queue_between=0) AS gaps_draining_fully,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gap_min WHERE min_queue_between>0) AS gaps_not_draining_fully,latency.p99_ms,latency.n_requests,sweep.horizon_s,sweep.mechanism,sweep.queue_imgs_final,eda.eda_rows FROM d CROSS JOIN s CROSS JOIN latency CROSS JOIN sweep CROSS JOIN eda GROUP BY d.window_name,d.encoder_workers,d.is_current,d.superseded_by,latency.p99_ms,latency.n_requests,sweep.horizon_s,sweep.mechanism,sweep.queue_imgs_final,eda.eda_rows
raw.observed: Current, unsuperseded burst1 run: 805 seconds above 1,000, peak 4,701, aggregate p99 5,013.37 ms, and 286 excursions lasting 1-27 sampled seconds. Of 285 inter-excursion gaps, 241 drain fully and 44 do not.

raw.evidence: The aggregate backlog and p99 values match, but a 1-second excursion disproves 'each ... multi-second,' and 44 non-draining gaps disprove 'drains fully between excursions'; eda_metric has no rows for this run.
